meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑一次视觉核对,用截图确认界面改动是否正常。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完界面都要靠肉眼反复确认有没有走样。
copy.tagline_en: Check any UI change with screenshots and get a clear pass-or-fail verdict.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep eyeballing every UI change to make sure nothing broke.

howto.what: 它会先对渲染出的界面(网页、终端 TUI、分页文档)截图并跑脚本产出对比 JSON,再并行派两个只读评审子代理复核,最后给出 PASS / REVISE / FAIL 判定。
howto.when: 你做完或改动任何界面后、或问某个页面、组件、TUI 看起来对不对时触发;没有渲染界面时跳过。

say.text: 帮我给这个页面做一次 visual QA
say.note: 会截图、跑脚本并派两个评审代理

say.text: 检查这个 TUI 有没有溢出或边框错位
say.note: 走真实 xterm.js 渲染截图后再判定

say.text: 对比我的实现和这张设计稿,给个结论
say.note: 同一视口截图后做像素对比

howto.what_en: It screenshots the rendered UI (web, terminal TUI, or paginated docs), runs an evidence script, dispatches two parallel read-only reviewers, then returns a PASS, REVISE, or FAIL verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI (web, TUI, etc.), or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skipped when nothing renders.

say_en.text: Run a visual QA pass on this page.
say_en.note: Captures, runs the script, dispatches two reviewers.

say_en.text: Check this TUI for overflow or broken borders.
say_en.note: Renders through real xterm.js, then judges.

say_en.text: Compare my build to this mock and give a verdict.
say_en.note: Same-viewport screenshots, then a pixel diff.
